decisions.quote: We replicate Ferris and Graddy's classic 1986 study of local government production and sector choice to assess how public procurement has changed over the past 35 years. Our findings show that today, contracting out is more commonly used across 25 local government service areas. In contrast to the original study, much of the growth has been in government‐to‐government contracts.
decisions.reason: The available abstract notes a contrast in government-to-government contract growth and describes other shifts over 35 years, but does not state the original study's specific empirical findings or whether any other tested relationships agreed in the unseen full text. Because abstract-only evidence cannot establish the absence of confirming comparisons in the full paper or verify a mixed verdict on its own, the outcome is undeterminable.
